test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that CANNOT be concluded from the given statements.

Statement 1: Some keys are boats.

Statement 2: Some boats are pipes.

Statement 3: All pipes are fish.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d48ebcc755b8011801219d231565c9bd0958cefed208accf410d31054b461d8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b79bf0cd0fe9e6fa4f2d02d21a191b112b5ca0d8d78a6d7a6f6ccc9d8f9bf70f.png] 

Conclusions:

Option 1) Some fish are keys → Does not follow (As some keys are boats, some boats are pipes and all pipes are fish. So it is possible but not definite.)

Option 2) Some fish are boats → Follow (As some boats are pipes and all pipes are fish. As whole pipes comes in fish and has some part common with boats, therefore it is true.)

Option 3) Some pipes are boats → Follow (As some boats are pipes. As boats has some part common with pipes, therefore it is true.)

Option 4) Some boats are keys → Follow (As some keys are boats. As keys has some part common with keys, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Conclusion 'Some fish are keys' follow.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
